newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE - JUNE 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE - JUNE 16.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- European partners near a compromise at Amsterdam summit, which may take the form of an introductory item calling for a balance between monetary stability and employment and social issues.
-- A extraordinary EU summit meeting on employment may be held in Luxembourg in October.
-- Former European Commission president Jacques Delors in an interview says governments must enhance explanation and consulting with citizens so that necessary reforms may be accepted.

-- Airbus partners British Aerospace and DASA have written to Aerospatiale chairman Yves Michot to insist on the need for strong integration of the aerospace industry in Europe, and call for a further restructuring of Airbus.
-- Armstrong to launch public buyout offer on the Canadian subsidiary of Sommer Allibert, Domco.
-- Eurotunnel minority shareholders start legal action against the company for alleged misuse of corporate funds and release of misleading information before 1994.
